name: Dokidoki☆Love Potion
original_name: どきどき☆らぶポーション
source:
One day while he's on his way to university, the protagonist Tsukasa meets up with a friend.  Actually his friend wanted to test out a potion he made, and had mixed it in Tsukasa's drink. A potion that is supposed to make you "sexy". However, upon testing it out, the potion actually seems to be one that makes him seem "sexy" to men!

Can Tsukasa protect his chastity for the week it takes until the effects wear off?!
translation:
一天，主角司正要去大学时遇到了朋友。原来朋友想测试自己制作的药剂，已经把药混进了司的饮料里。

这是一种据说能让人变得“性感”的药剂。然而测试之后，司发现它的效果似乎是让男性觉得自己“性感”！

司能保护自己的贞操，熬过药效消退前的一周吗？
